These are unmodified public repository configuration files installed by
`issabel-framework-5.0.0-5.noarch` (`Issabel.repo`, `Issabel5.repo`) and
`issabel-addons-5.0.0-1.noarch` (`commercial-addons.repo`) during the Rocky 8.10
fresh-install rehearsal. They contain upstream URLs and public signing-key
locations only. SHA-256 identities are pinned in the repair helper.

The RPM file flags are empty. Packages can overwrite these files on upgrade;
comment-only handoff files do not prevent that. The installer must revalidate
after its package stages and before subsequent package commands on resume.
